div.div: Every human message in a bridged channel, top-level or in a thread, is pushed to one workstream by the Slack bridge and acked once its relay accepts it, never polled; Ember traces the session tree and the active Slack user

switch.text: Every human message in a bridged channel, top-level or in a thread, is pushed to one workstream by the Slack bridge and acked once its relay accepts it, never polled; Ember traces the session tree and the active Slack user

div.div:
Teammate A
reply in a claimed thread

Teammate B
@Crucible ember: or forge: prefix

Thread replies
bridge ack once the relay accepts:
"Sent to <Ws>." or an eyes reaction;
else a retrying / could-not-deliver
notice; the workstream answers
and @mentions the requester

text.tspan: bridge ack once the relay accepts:

div.div:
Verify · filter · dedupe
Slack signature · skip bots, external
users and unbridged channels · stop if
the message record (channel:ts) exists

text.tspan: users and unbridged channels · stop if

div.div:
Route + record, then 200
1 directive: prefix or @Crucible <ws>:
2 thread claim (KV)
3 channel map: #crucible-work → Root
then message record (KV), and the
thread map for a top-level message

text.tspan: thread map for a top-level message

div.div:
Deliver
reserve from the hourly budget ·
relay POST with retries, else
pending for the cron · ack only
after the relay answers 2xx

text.tspan: pending for the cron · ack only

div.div:
Root
routes #crucible-work requests:
issue (ws:* label), thread claim,
reserve, POST to the project relay

text.tspan: reserve, POST to the project relay

div.div:
Crucible · Forge
orchestrator + one agent per
issue, within its budget → its PR

text.tspan: issue, within its budget → its PR

orchestrator + one agent per
issue, within its budget → its PR

div.div:
Crucible · Other
orchestrator + one agent per
issue, within its budget → its PR

div.div:
Dashboard
the session tree and who
asked / is active

Ember
joins every session, subagent
and tool call (OTLP) into one
tree: Root → workstream →
agent; attributes it to the
active Slack user

slack-ledger.jsonl
route · reply lines: Root mirrors
the bridge's GET /ledger; projects
append agent · pr lines;
usage per requester
